body.statement:
Write \(\mathcal G_n=\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n\) and \(A_n=(A_{n1},\ldots,A_{nn})^\top\).  On \(\mathcal G_n\), the unique exact-balancing weights imply
\[
 Q_n^\top d_n=0,
 \qquad
 \mathbb E[\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2\mid Q_n,A_n]
 =\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2+
 \operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^\top),
\]
and \(L_n=(Q_n^\top Q_n)^{-1}Q_n^\top\).  At \(\gamma=1\), there are constants \(\kappa_0\in(0,\kappa_{\mathrm{bal}})\) and \(0<c<C<\infty\), independent of \(\kappa\), such that, for every fixed \(0<\kappa<\kappa_0\) with \(p_n/n\to\kappa\),
\[
 \mathbb P\!\left(
 \mathcal G_n\cap
 \left\{c\kappa\le
 \|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2+
 \operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^\top)
 \le C\kappa\right\}\right)\longrightarrow1,
\]
\[
 \|H_nu_n\|_2^2+\|H_n\|_{\mathrm F}^2
 \longrightarrow_{\mathbb P}0,
 \qquad H_n=(L_nD_n)^\top(L_nD_n),
\]
and consequently, after changing \(c,C\) by fixed factors if necessary,
\[
 \mathbb P\{c\kappa\le\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2\le C\kappa\}
 \longrightarrow1.
\]
Thus the proportional-then-small-\(\kappa\) quadratic diagnostic has a two-sided order bracket with fixed positive finite constants.  This statement does not assert a deterministic equivalent, does not identify the coefficient of \(\kappa\), and does not imply the fixed-\(\lambda\) regret expansion \(r_E=\kappa/(8\lambda)+o(\kappa)\).
body.proof_tex:
The finite-sample assertions follow from Lemma \(\mathrm{lem{:}exact\mbox{-}eb\mbox{-}quadratic\mbox{-}identity}\): on \(\mathcal G_n\), exact pooled-target balance gives \(Q_n^\top d_n=0\), full rank gives \(L_n=(Q_n^\top Q_n)^{-1}Q_n^\top\), and conditional independence of the Bernoulli outcomes gives the displayed conditional second moment.

At \(\gamma=1\), Lemma \(\mathrm{lem{:}small\mbox{-}aspect\mbox{-}entropy\mbox{-}upper\mbox{-}leverage}\) supplies \(\kappa_0\) and \(C_0\), independent of \(\kappa\), such that for every fixed \(0<\kappa<\kappa_0\),
\[
 \mathbb P\{\mathcal G_n,\ M_{E,n}\le C_0\kappa\}\to1,
 \qquad
 \|H_nu_n\|_2^2+\|H_n\|_{\mathrm F}^2\to_{\mathbb P}0,
 \tag{1}
\]
where
\[
 M_{E,n}=\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2+
 \operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^\top).
\]
The lower bound no longer comes from the small-aspect cavity argument.  Lemma \(\mathrm{lem{:}global\mbox{-}feasible\mbox{-}entropy\mbox{-}energy\mbox{-}floor}\), applied at \(\gamma=1\), gives for every \(\varepsilon>0\),
\[
 \mathbb P\!\left[
 \mathcal G_n\cap
 \left\{
 \frac{\operatorname{tr}(L_nD_nV_nD_nL_n^\top)}\kappa
 \ge \frac4{(2+2e^{1/2})(1+\sqrt\kappa)^4}-\varepsilon
 \right\}\right]\to1.
 \tag{2}
\]
After decreasing \(\kappa_0\) if necessary, define
\[
 c_0=\frac2{(2+2e^{1/2})(1+\sqrt{\kappa_0})^4}>0.
\]
Taking \(\varepsilon=c_0\) in (2), and using the nonnegativity of \(\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2\), yields
\[
 \mathbb P\{\mathcal G_n,\ c_0\kappa\le M_{E,n}\le C_0\kappa\}\to1.
 \tag{3}
\]

Let
\[
 C_n=\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2-M_{E,n}.
\]
The conditional Chebyshev bound in Lemma \(\mathrm{lem{:}entropy\mbox{-}weighted\mbox{-}quadratic\mbox{-}fluctuations}\) and (1) imply, for every fixed \(t>0\),
\[
 \mathbb P(|C_n|>t)\to0.
 \tag{4}
\]
For the fixed positive \(\kappa\) under consideration, take \(t=c_0\kappa/2\).  Combining (3)--(4) gives
\[
 \mathbb P\!\left\{
 \frac{c_0}2\kappa\le\|b_{E,n}\|_2^2
 \le\left(C_0+\frac{c_0}2\right)\kappa
 \right\}\to1.
\]
Renaming constants proves the proposition.  The proof establishes neither convergence of either conditional-energy term nor any link between this strong-penalty diagnostic and the selected global optimizer at fixed \(\lambda\); hence no deterministic equivalent, coefficient-one claim, regret constant, or phase cell is inferred.
body.justification: The original same-sample entropy quadratic has an explicit conditional-energy floor throughout the feasible region and a concentrated two-sided order bracket at sufficiently small aspect ratio.
body.gap: The upper and leverage arguments remain small-aspect, and no deterministic coefficient or link to the fixed-penalty global policy optimizer is proved.
body.consumer: The result validates the scale of a strong-penalty diagnostic but supplies no regret ranking or phase label.
